source.html:
Alice's White Bread
 
Save Print
Author: Genevieve Hammil
Ingredients
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) sugar
  • 2 Teaspoon(s) salt
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) olive oil
  • 2 Cup(s) water
  • 2 Teaspoon(s) active dry yeast
Instructions
  1. Combine yeast, sugar, salt, oil and warm water in a large bowl.
  2. Add flour 1 cup at a time and mix. Keep adding flour until the dough no longer sticks to your hands and when you poke with your finger, the dough bounces back.
  3. Knead until nice and smooth.
  4. Place dough in oiled bowl and turn the dough over. Cover with cloth and let rise until doubled (1 hour).
  5. Punch down and let rise until doubled (1 hour).
  6. Divide into 2 portions. Shape each into large rectangle. On the longer side, roll up. Fold ends under and place seam side down on baking sheet. Cut 3 diagonal ½" slits in top of bread.
  7. Cover with cloth and let rise until doubled (1 hour).
  8. Preheat oven to 350. Bake for 32 minutes, rotating halfway.
  9. Let cool and wrap in foil. Freeze. Reheat at 300 for 20-25 minutes in foil.
